feima.auth.baseUrl.markdownDescription: OAuth2 authentication server base URL (overrides region default)

feima.api.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Model inference API server base URL (overrides region default)

feima.auth.clientId.markdownDescription: OAuth2 client ID for authentication (overrides region default)

feima.promotionUrl.markdownDescription: URL for the credits promotion page (shown when balance runs out)

feima.website.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL for the Feima website (used for profile and activity log links)

feima.showQuotaInStatusBar.description: Show remaining request quota in status bar

feima.warnWhenQuotaLow.description: Show warning when remaining requests drop below this number

feima.agents.codex.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `codex` binary. Leave empty to auto-discover via PATH.

feima.agents.copilot.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the GitHub Copilot CLI binary. Leave empty to auto-discover via PATH.

feima.agents.claude.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `claude` binary. Leave empty to auto-discover via PATH.

feima.agents.codex.shareMcpServers.markdownDescription: Pass MCP servers from VS Code's own native mcp.json config (user profile + every workspace folder's `.vscode/mcp.json`) down to @codex. Disable if you only want @codex's own separately configured MCP servers (e.g. via `codex mcp add`).

feima.agents.copilot.shareMcpServers.markdownDescription: Pass MCP servers from VS Code's own native mcp.json config (user profile + every workspace folder's `.vscode/mcp.json`) down to @copilot-cli. Disable if you only want the Copilot CLI's own separately configured MCP servers.

feima.agents.claude.shareMcpServers.markdownDescription: Pass MCP servers from VS Code's own native mcp.json config (user profile + every workspace folder's `.vscode/mcp.json`) down to @claude, letting the Claude Agent SDK connect to them itself. **Defaults to off**, because the Claude Agent SDK's own MCP client can't complete OAuth — servers that need it (e.g. Atlassian) silently fail to connect. Instead, by default those servers are managed by VS Code (which does support OAuth) and their tools are exposed to @claude through the dynamic-tool bridge, see `#feima.agents.claude.tools.excludePatterns#`. Enable this only for MCP servers you want @claude's own SDK to connect to directly.

feima.agents.tools.excludePatterns.markdownDescription: Tool names (from `vscode.lm.tools`) to hide from the dynamic-tool bridge shared by agent participants. Supports a single `*` wildcard per pattern. The default excludes MCP-backed tools (`mcp_*` — MCP servers are handled natively by each CLI's own MCP client, see `.vscode/mcp.json`), a few Copilot Chat manifest-only tools with no runtime implementation, and internal agent-loop control signals from other agent SDKs.

feima.agents.codex.tools.excludePatterns.markdownDescription: Overrides `#feima.agents.tools.excludePatterns#` for @codex only. Leave unset (`null`) to use the shared list; set to an array (including `[]`) to replace it just for @codex.

feima.agents.copilot.tools.excludePatter.markdownDescription: Overrides `#feima.agents.tools.excludePatterns#` for @copilot-cli only. Leave unset (`null`) to use the shared list; set to an array (including `[]`) to replace it just for @copilot-cli.

feima.agents.claude.tools.excludePattern.markdownDescription: Overrides `#feima.agents.tools.excludePatterns#` for @claude only. **Defaults to the shared list minus `mcp_*`**, so VS Code-managed MCP tools (including OAuth-authenticated ones the Claude SDK can't reach on its own, see `#feima.agents.claude.shareMcpServers#`) are exposed to @claude via the dynamic-tool bridge. Set to `null` to fall back to the shared list (which excludes `mcp_*`); set to a custom array (including `[]`) to replace it.

feima.agents.codex.maxApiCallsPerTurn.markdownDescription: Maximum number of model API calls Codex may make within a single turn before it's force-interrupted. Guards against a runaway loop (e.g. the model repeatedly calling tools without converging) that would otherwise never reach `turn/completed`.

enumDescriptions: Ask for approval before running commands or changing files (safe default).
Auto-approve file edits; still ask before running commands or other tools.
Auto-approve everything; never ask. Use with caution.
feima.agents.codex.permissionMode.markdownDescription: Default permission tier for @codex: how much it asks before running commands or changing files. Override for a single turn with `/ask`, `/acceptEdits` or `/fullAuto`.

feima.agents.codex.systemPrompt.markdownDescription: Extra instructions for @codex, layered on top of Codex's own built-in agent instructions as `developerInstructions`. There is no additional Feima-provided default — this setting is purely for your own customization. See `#feima.agents.codex.systemPromptMode#`.

enumDescriptions: Send your text as-is (safe default; there's nothing Feima-provided to append it to). Codex's own built-in agent instructions always apply regardless of this setting — there is no way to fully override those.
Same as append — with no Feima-provided default, 'replace' has no additional effect for @codex today. Kept for consistency with @claude/@copilot-cli's `systemPromptMode` setting.
feima.agents.codex.systemPromptMode.markdownDescription: How `#feima.agents.codex.systemPrompt#` is applied for @codex. Currently equivalent either way — see enum descriptions.

feima.agents.copilot.maxApiCallsPerTurn.markdownDescription: Maximum number of model API calls the Copilot CLI may make within a single turn before it's force-aborted. Guards against a runaway loop (e.g. the model repeatedly calling tools without converging) that would otherwise never reach `session.idle`.

enumDescriptions: Ask for approval before running commands or changing files (safe default).
Auto-approve file edits; still ask before running commands or other tools.
Auto-approve everything; never ask. Use with caution.
feima.agents.copilot.permissionMode.markdownDescription: Default permission tier for @copilot-cli: how much it asks before running commands or changing files. Override for a single turn with `/ask`, `/acceptEdits` or `/fullAuto`.

feima.agents.copilot.systemPrompt.markdownDescription: Extra instructions for @copilot-cli. There is no additional Feima-provided default — this setting is purely for your own customization. See `#feima.agents.copilot.systemPromptMode#` for how it's applied.

enumDescriptions: Append your text after the Copilot CLI's own default system message (safe default).

Use only your text in `#feima.agents.copilot.systemPrompt#` as the entire system message — this discards the Copilot CLI's own default system message, including its safety guardrails. Advanced use only.
feima.agents.copilot.systemPromptMode.markdownDescription: How `#feima.agents.copilot.systemPrompt#` combines with the Copilot CLI's own default system message.

feima.agents.claude.maxApiCallsPerTurn.markdownDescription: Maximum number of model round-trips the Claude Agent SDK may make within a single turn (its own `maxTurns` option). Guards against a runaway loop (e.g. the model repeatedly calling tools without converging); past this, the SDK ends the turn itself instead of running unbounded.

enumDescriptions: Ask for approval before running commands or changing files (safe default).
Auto-approve file edits; still ask before running commands or other tools.
Auto-approve everything; never ask. Use with caution.
feima.agents.claude.permissionMode.markdownDescription: Default permission tier for @claude: how much it asks before running commands or changing files. Override for a single turn with `/ask`, `/acceptEdits` or `/fullAuto`.

feima.agents.claude.systemPrompt.markdownDescription: Extra instructions for @claude, on top of Claude Code's own default persona/instructions and Feima's built-in VS Code context notes. See `#feima.agents.claude.systemPromptMode#` for how this combines with those defaults.

enumDescriptions: Keep Claude Code's own default persona/instructions plus Feima's built-in VS Code context notes, and append your text after them (safe default).

Use only your text in `#feima.agents.claude.systemPrompt#` as the entire system prompt — this discards both Claude Code's own default persona/instructions and Feima's built-in notes. Advanced use only.
feima.agents.claude.systemPromptMode.markdownDescription: How `#feima.agents.claude.systemPrompt#` combines with the built-in defaults for @claude.
